reading.body:
Stream Chicago II in Elk Grove Village is a fully leased data center campus operated by Stream Data Centers, a tier-1 operator now majority-owned by Apollo Global Management as of November 2025. The facility's power capacity is not published. Without a published megawatt figure, this campus cannot be ranked within Illinois' known capacity, though Stream operates at least two other Chicago-area facilities that are tracked separately.

Illinois has 44 mapped data center facilities, of which only 6 publish power specifications totaling 236 megawatts of known capacity. Stream Chicago II's unpublished capacity means it does not factor into the state's measured footprint, despite the operator's public positioning as a Fortune 100-serving platform with a 4-plus-gigawatt active pipeline across more than 20 delivered campuses.

The absence of a published specification for this fully leased facility is notable for grid planning. A fully leased site at a tier-1 operator typically runs at or near nameplate capacity, yet the binding constraint on Illinois' AI infrastructure visibility remains the unwillingness of most operators to disclose the power load their tenants are drawing. Without that figure from Stream's own disclosure, the actual demand this campus represents to Illinois' grid cannot be read.
